lines: A weapon means little without the nerve to use it at the gate. You had that nerve.
You kept your edge when the village lost its breath. That deserves respect.
You used force for the village, not against it. That distinction matters.
Your control kept people alive when anger would have failed them.
I saw neighbors stand together behind the line you held.
The bell gave us enough time to arm the defenders.
You chose courage without chasing glory.
The houses are standing because the gate did not fall.
I watched you cover people who could not defend themselves.
The attackers broke before the village did.
Every sound blade in the rack mattered that day.
You proved that discipline protects better than fury.
I will keep the village weapons ready for people who earn them.
The defenders brought back bent steel and steady eyes.
You gave the golem room to reach the fight.
I remember the gate shaking and your feet staying planted.
A clean strike matters less than knowing where to stand.
You fought for the people behind you. I respect that.
The forge is busy because the village survived. That is good work.
If the next horn sounds, I want you near the gate again.
